headline: 99°F Thursday — harvest onions, dig potatoes Wednesday.
weather_notes: Water all zones today — last moisture was Aug 16 (2 days) and today's 93°F triggers the 1-day heat re-water threshold.
Schedule all outdoor harvesting and pruning for Tuesday or Wednesday morning — 99°F Thursday closes comfortable work windows through the weekend.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds by 11 AM daily — 93–99°F this week risks sunscald with Phoenix harvest opening Aug 24.
